simple.meaning: דָּגוֹן (Dâgôwn) appears 13 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.

definitions.full: H1712. Dagon דָּגוֺן proper name, masculine : 1Sam 5:4 god & idol of Philistines (compare Assyrian Dagan, Dakan(nu) , name perhaps non-Shemitic COT Judg 16:23 Dl Pa 139 Sayce Rel. Babylonian 188 f. but see Jen below) **oldest tradition (Jerome) seems to waver between דָּג fish and דָּגָן grain , as explanation of דָּגוֺן , see בית . — god of Ashdod, except 16:23 (Gaza) & 1Chr 10:10 (but compare below); — אֱלֹהֵיהֶם דגון Judg 16:23 compare אֱלֹהֵינוּ דגון 1Sam 5:7 , ד ׳בֵּית 5:2 , 5 ; 1Chr 10:10 (here hardly original compare || 1Sam 31:10 & We Dr); ד ׳כֹּהֲנֵי 5:5 , ד ׳מִפְתַּן 5:5 ; as name of image ד ׳(אֵצֶל) 5:2 ; 5:3 ; 5:4 , נֹפֵל דגון 5:3 ; 5:4 , ד ׳רַק עָלָיו נִשְׁאַר 5:4 (but sense difficult; We proposes דָּגוֺ only his fish , i.e. fishy part, was left upon him , see also Dr; — but was Dagon a fish-god ? compare works cited above & Scholz G-tzendienst 238 ff. , Baud in PRE 2iii. 460 ff. especially Jen Kosmol. 449 ff. ) see דָּגוֺן בֵּית p. III.
